name: Magocha Ojii-chan Yamete!
original_name: まごちゃ おじいちゃんやめて!
source:
This is a fully voiced adventure about a pretty care attendant girl and old men!

The caregiver for the old man resembled his deceased wife.
His mind continues to blur, and he attacks the girl one day.
Her resistance was in vain, and she is exposed to very hard assaults.
Not only that, he calls up his friends to join the act...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180512173619/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE065316.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一款全程配音的冒险游戏，讲述一名可爱的护工少女与一群老男人的故事！

照顾老人的护工，长得很像他已经去世的妻子。
老人的意识日益混浊，终于在某天向少女发动了袭击。
她的抵抗毫无意义，紧接着便遭到了极其激烈的蹂躏。
不仅如此，老人还打电话叫来朋友，要他们也加入其中……

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180512173619/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE065316.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
